description: An empty foreign part after one pause gives `?` to the phonemes of a token over it, with no pause after the `?`. The label keeps the one pause and gains nothing. The word stage's empty `zoi` quote has this shape, and a letter word over it sounds `zoi.gy.?gy.bu` (engine §5, §11).
grammar:
%rule text $w(letter)
%emits $w <W>
%rule letter quote P L
%rule quote L P $b(body) L
%emits $b <F>
%rule body ε
%foreign
